_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Software License Requirements List
summary: The Software License Requirements List provides information that sustainment activities require to procure software licenses needed to operate and maintain software intensive systems.
use_relationship:
The Software License Requirements List provides information that sustainment activities require to procure software licenses required to operate and maintain software intensive systems as part of the Department of Defense Program Manager's total life cycle management responsibilities.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use of information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the solicitation.
The data may be obtained during any program life cycle phase.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor's format is acceptable. The Software License Requirements List shall be in a format similar to that of Table 1 and shall be provided in an electronic format compatible with current spreadsheet applications (ex. Microsoft Excel)

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Software License Requirements List shall contain all of the information specified in Table 1. All fields shall be included. Fields that do not require data shall be left blank. The information shall be included for all software licenses required to operate the system specified in the contract.
